general_information.Description: -Main objective: The aim of this subject is to integrate knowledge with front office, housekeeping and others relevant departments in accommodation and apply them to problem solving in the areas of room division management. The course provides learners the necessary knowledge and skills to become a room division manager. -Description: During the course, students are practiced to design a room division department, apply the plan in real operation. Learners will be trained in management skills in several key aspects of room division management including operational administration, human resource management and departmental revenue optimization. -Teaching method: Lecture, Desmontration, Role Play, Project based learning, Cooperative Learning
general_information.StudentTasks: Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Comply with the time and regulation - Professional grooming - Respect and protect school asset. - Strongly communication and teamworking.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Design an overall standard of procedures plan of hotel or resort operation
Describe functions of different departments of a hotel and building the interrelationships among departments.
Apply management skills in designing the service process in room division
Evaluate service quality of room division
Communicate in a professional and courtesy Brand’s style
Identify and resolve problems relevant to accommodation areas
Develop corporate social responsibility expected of professionals working in accommodation

assessments.Note: Student is required to create training plan and employee performance appraisal program for their chosen hotel. All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and must be submitted in soft copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission.
Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots Attendance check at any time during course

assessments.Note: Students have 3 roles to play: 01 role as a staff to perform the randomly assigned tasks, 01 role as a supervisor/ manager to evaluate peer's performance, and 01 role as a guest. Supervisors/ Managers will be provided a standard checklist to evaluate their peers' performance. Note: In this exam: + Students will be randomly assigned in group and role by lecturer. + Inviting professionals in hotel industry to join in this exam.
